instruction: Consume V1 WITHHOLD. Fetch up to 2500 real EVA GitHub Actions runs and, for each real failed-run recovery episode, fetch the current run jobs/steps. Add only evidence available at the failure: failed step type/position, compile/setup/fetch vs semantic gate/test/train vs canonical/invariant/persist, duration, streak and attempt. Split by workflow-name hash so train, validation and blind contain disjoint workflow names; do not expose workflow names to models. LOGIC predicts actual next same-workflow recovery; THINKING learns response ordering from current failure category; INTELLIGENCE learns current risk; COGNITIVE sees only organ outputs and must select RETRY_AFTER_FIX, VERIFY_RECOVERY, WITHHOLD_ESCALATE, or REPLAN. Require macro metrics, single-organ baselines, individual/combined ablations, source hashes and unchanged canonical G2.
